errors.message:
AGENTS.md has no cyanotype header, so it was written by hand, and cyanotype never replaces it without a choice.
Choose one with --existing on the command line, or the existing argument of the MCP tools:
  import   returns a prompt that has your coding agent turn its rules into cyanotype.yaml; nothing is written
  keep     the whole file goes in a cyanotype:custom block, which regeneration keeps
  move     its content goes to docs/agents/original-<name>, which the main file tells the agent to read
  replace  overwrite it with the generated file; only when git has it committed, so it can be recovered
